source: UK Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: 2026 methodology
units: g CO2e per passenger-km before distance and radiative-forcing uplifts
notes: The 2026 methodology recommends an 8% uplift to great-circle distance for indirect routing, delays, congestion and circling.
The 2026 methodology provides an indicative 1.7 radiative-forcing multiplier applied to the CO2 component only; this estimate uses that optional uplift.
For this non-UK personal travel ledger, 3,700 km is used as a pragmatic distance proxy for short- versus long-haul rather than the UK-specific geographic classification.
These are direct flight-operation factors and do not add separate well-to-tank fuel lifecycle emissions.
